notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.notes:
Innovations

 Added learning level
 Non-editable world templates
Not all world templates can now be completely edited and their generation system can be changed
 Extended hints of slots with items
 Description of some items
 Hint button
Appears to the right of the text input field in the chat for some commands: /give, /effect, /setObject, /summon
 The ability to extract resin from wood
To do this, pick up a knife, go to the tree, right-click on the object and with a probability of 40%  you will get resin. The largest tree  has the maximum number of attempts equal to 6.
 Game rule "One life"
 Command /setObject
Allows you to place objects in the world
 System of broken things
If the strength of the item has dropped to 1 unit, then the item becomes broken and its functionality is lost. You can fix it on the anvil using the resources to fix it.
 Ability to create chains of commands
Example: /command;/command;/command... and so on
 Command /summon
Allows you to summon an entity
 Throwing a snowball into the fire - its burning time will decrease
  GorenjeA bucket of water can be filled with drops from the dropper
 A bucket of water can put out the fire
If you put out a small fire with a bucket of water, it will not disappear and it can be lit again 
 The inscription of the selected item in the hand above the quick access panel
 Jetpack now loses strength during flight
Like other items that lose their strength, it can be repaired on an anvil using an iron ingot
 Snow and eggs can now be thrown by holding them in your hand
 Apples now appear on trees
The size of the tree depends on the number of apples that can grow on it randomly
 Added wooden hoe
 You can water the beds with a bucket of water
When watering the bed, the growth rate is doubled until the next stage of growth 


Changes

 Some objects in my hand now emit light and particles
 The Russian translation
  has been redoneThe system of loosening the bed
Now to create a garden bed, there must be land in the inventory 
 Bushes with red berries now appear in the "Creepy Forest" world template
 Placement of objects
In order  to place an object, now you need to hold down and hold the right mouse button. To cancel the placement of the object - press the left mouse button
 A bucket of water needs to be poured into the boiler to start cooking
 The shadow at night is now slightly lighter
 Changed the camera control in the note book
 Completely changed the control of a player with a jetpack on 
After placing the jetpack in the bib slot, press the space bar twice and you will start flying. To stop flying, press the space bar again 2 times.


Error correction

 The player's stamina was spent when pressing Left Shift even if the player was standing still
 The player's stats displayed his statuses incorrectly
 The buttons on the death screen displayed an incorrect translation
 The boiler had no cooking functionality and its interaction panel did not open correctly
 When creating items, the crafting window did not see items in the Quick access toolbar
 It was not possible to pick up eggs from the nest with the right mouse button
 No torches appeared in crafting recipes
